title: Technical Recruiter
description:
Exa is an applied AI lab building a search engine unlike the world has ever seen. We build massive-scale infra to crawl the entire web, train state-of-the-art embedding models to process it, and design super high performant vector databases to retrieve over it. We now power search for Cursor, Cognition, HubSpot, and over 400,000 developers and have raised $350m from Lightspeed, Benchmark, and a16z.

 

Our ultimate goal is to build perfect search over all the world's information, far beyond Google. If you want to build massive-scale ML systems that will define the way the new AI world consumes information, this is the place for you.

We’re looking for a Technical Recruiter to help build our Exa family!

About the Role

As a Technical Recruiter at Exa, you’ll work directly with the founders and leadership team to scale our company. This isn’t a standard recruiting job-you’ll be recruiting in the age of AI, using in-house agentic systems built on top of our own search engine to supercharge the process. You’ll not only help build our early, world-class technical team, but also design the recruiting systems that let us scale rapidly. If you understand the SF tech/startup ecosystem and can speak the language of engineers (bonus if you can code yourself), you’ll thrive here.

What You’ll Do

- Own the technical recruiting cycle end-to-end: sourcing, outreach, interviews, and closing

- Represent Exa externally and convince top-tier engineers, researchers, and operators to join

- Partner with founders and team leads to scope roles and identify high-leverage hires

- Build and optimize recruiting systems and workflows using Exa’s in-house agentic search tools

- Experiment with creative sourcing strategies to stand out in the competitive SF startup market

- Help shape Exa’s talent brand and recruiting culture as we scale hyperspeed (1.5x+ headcount growth each quarter)

Desired Experience

- 2+ years of experience recruiting for technical roles in startups or high-growth tech companies

- Familiarity with SF startup culture-you know how to identify and attract top 1% startup talent

- Strong communication skills-you can tell a compelling story and sell a big vision

- Technical literacy (bonus if you can code or have a technical background). You’re expected to communicate our ongoing engineering projects to technical candidates.

- A builder mindset-you want to design recruiting systems, not just run them

- Comfort in a fast-moving, high-growth startup environment

We are open to sponsoring international candidates (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H1B, O1, E3). In addition to premium healthcare benefits (medical, dental, vision), we also offer fertility benefits and a monthly wellness stipend to all of our employees.

Exa is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related conditions, criminal histories consistent with applicable law, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

title: Principal Product Manager
description:
Who You Are:
You combine deep technical domain expertise with a strong focus on customer outcomes, defining what gets built, why it matters, and how it improves the decisions customers make every day. You bring highly structured thinking, a customer-obsessed mindset, strong written communication, and the technical depth to lead meaningful conversations with engineering, executive, and customer stakeholders alike.
Invicti is looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager to own our Code & Developer Security product area - spanning SAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, and Secrets Detection. This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role for someone who wants to build products that security and engineering teams actually trust: better signal, less noise, faster fixes. These products will be a significant part of the Invicti AppSec Platform.
What You’ll Be Doing:
AI is changing how software gets written, and it's changing this product area faster than almost any other. Development teams using AI coding assistants are shipping more code, faster, with less visibility into what's in it. That means larger attack surfaces, more opaque dependency chains, more auto-generated IaC, and secrets in places no one reviewed. The tools that win in this environment won't just scan more, they'll surface what actually matters, with enough context that a developer can act on it without filing a ticket.
At the same time, Invicti 's portfolio is expanding. Our recently delivered ASPM platform creates a correlation layer above individual scan results. Octo, our agentic offensive security capability, is beginning to close the loop between static findings and validated exploitability. The Code Security product area sits at the foundation of this stack, and this PM will shape how those connections get built.
What You'll Own:

• Full product ownership for the Code Security product area, SAST, SCA, IaC, Container Security, and Secrets Detection, across the Invicti and Acunetix product lines

• Roadmap definition and prioritization grounded in customer evidence, market data, and portfolio strategy.

• A point of view on how AI-assisted development changes the threat model, and how our scanning, triage, and remediation capabilities need to evolve in response

• Positioning in a highly competitive market that includes incumbents and a growing set of AI-native entrants rethinking what static analysis can do

Requirements
What You'll Need:

• 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years in a technical PM role at a security, developer tools, or infrastructure company desired

• Familiarity with at least two of the core domains: SAST, SCA, IaC security, container security, or secrets management

• A perspective on how AI-assisted development changes the security problem

• Strong written communication

• Experience working in a multi-product environment where roadmap decisions require cross-portfolio thinking

• The ability to move with conviction under ambiguity, and the seniority to bring others along through influence

• Strong ability to use current AI tools to improve the product development lifecycle.

• Added Bonus:

• Prior experience at a SAST, SCA, or software supply chain security vendor

• Exposure to ASPM platforms or consolidated security findings workflows

• Background shipping developer-facing products or integrations into CI/CD pipelines

Benefits

Who We Are:
Invicti Security helps more than 4,000 organizations worldwide secure web applications and APIs with the industry’s most accurate application security platform, powered by 20 years of technology leadership in DAST. Combining proof-based testing, runtime intelligence, and continuous innovation, Invicti enables AppSec teams to identify real risk, reduce alert noise, and ship secure software faster.
Invicti 's proof-based philosophy, validate what's actually exploitable before surfacing it, sets a high bar for signal quality. Code Security is where that philosophy needs to

title: Marketing Associate - Affiliate marketing (f/m/x) (~5 hours/week, mini-job)
description:
intro
As our Marketing Associate - Affiliate marketing for one of our key insurance partnerships, you will be responsible for managing the existing affiliate network as well as onboarding new affiliates into the network. You’ll manage the day-to-day relationship with affiliates in German and English.

This is a flexible, mini-job role (around ~5 hours/week) on a one-year contract.

This position offers hands-on ownership of an established partnership within our marketing team - a great fit if you like working independently and delivering steady, dependable results.

At Feather , we're building insurance that actually matters to our customers. It rests on three principles: a fully digital experience, modern and flexible plans, and reliable human support. And because we build it all for expats living abroad, we're a genuinely different kind of insurer.
why work at feather?

•
We’re small, lean, and we love what we do. The usual buzzwords here, except we actually mean them. Staying small helps us focus on what matters, and we want to keep it that way.

•
You’ll work on a product that is loved by customers. Our excellent Trustpilot and Google reviews speak for themselves.

•
There's plenty of space to grow. We trust you to take ownership and make decisions from day one, and we will give you all the support and mentorship you need to succeed.

•
Flexible remote work policy. We offer a remote-first work environment with an office in Berlin. We host company retreats, team dinners, and meetups to spend in-person time together.

what you bring to the table

• You have some experience in affiliate marketing, partnership management, or a similar relationship-focused role.

• You're comfortable maintaining relationships day-to-day over email, calls, and video calls.

• You're comfortable using everyday software tools (Slack, Notion, Google Suite, and similar) and can pick up new tools quickly.

• You're someone who takes initiative and can manage your own workload independently, without needing close supervision once you're settled in.

• You're fluent in German and English.

you'll be responsible for

• You will manage our existing affiliate network for this partnership, in German and English, acting as the main point of contact for day-to-day questions and onboarding new affiliates as they join.

• You will build and maintain strong relationships with our affiliates to keep the partnership running smoothly.

• You will monitor affiliate performance and flag issues early, sharing clear, simple reporting with the team.

• You will use good judgment to know when to handle something directly versus when to escalate without needing close supervision.

• You will handle commission payments, as well as regular financial reporting and reconciliation for the partnership, keeping records accurate and up to date.

what will the interview process look like?

• CV screening

•
Initial video call - We’ll have a chat and get to know each other (25min)

•
Take-home task - We'll give you a task to work on, which will give you an idea of the type of projects you'd take on at Feather (2-3h)

•
Take-home task discussion - We'll go through the task to work on together, so we make sure that we understand your reasoning and approach (60min)

•
Expectations & alignment conversation - A conversation with the Head of Marketing to align on expectations, ways of working, and next steps, including a review of insights from the previous interviews (30min)

does this sound like a good fit for you? apply now!
At Feather , we actively foster inclusive representation within our teams and embrace a diverse mix of talent. We encourage applicants from all educational paths to apply: we believe that what you’ve built, worked on, and achieved is far more important than on-paper qualifications.

title: Capture Excellence - Cost Estimator
description:
Franklin Energy is redefining the clean energy future as the only integrated provider of comprehensive solutions, combining unmatched expertise in strategic consulting, program delivery, product solutions, and design/build services. Powered by our advanced AI-driven technology platforms, we deliver seamless, tech-driven support across the entire energy service ecosystem to accelerate impactful change and ensure an unmatched customer experience. Since 1994, Franklin Energy has been a trusted partner in protecting communities and our planet, paving the way for a sustainable future for all. Learn more at www.franklinenergy.com and join us in leading the clean energy revolution.
POSITION SUMMARY
THE COST ESTIMATOR IS RESPONSIBLE FOR DEVELOPING ACCURATE COST ESTIMATES AND FINANCIAL MODELS THAT SUPPORT BID AND PROPOSAL ACTIVITIES ACROSS FRANKLIN ENERGY. WORKING CLOSELY WITH THE PRINCIPAL COST ESTIMATOR AND CROSS-FUNCTIONAL TEAMS INCLUDING BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT, CLIENT DELIVERY, FINANCE, ENGINEERING, PRODUCT SOLUTIONS, AND STRATEGY, THIS ROLE DEVELOPS PRICING MODELS, ANALYZES COST INPUTS, AND SUPPORTS COMPETITIVE PRICING STRATEGIES FOR NEW BUSINESS OPPORTUNITIES.
THE COST ESTIMATOR PLAYS A KEY ROLE IN ENSURING PROPOSALS ARE FINANCIALLY SOUND, DATA-DRIVEN, AND ALIGNED WITH ORGANIZATIONAL GOALS. THIS POSITION REQUIRES STRONG ANALYTICAL SKILLS, ATTENTION TO DETAIL, AND THE ABILITY TO COLLABORATE WITH MULTIPLE STAKEHOLDERS TO GATHER INPUTS, EVALUATE ASSUMPTIONS, AND DELIVER CLEAR AND ACCURATE COST ESTIMATES WITHIN TIGHT PROPOSAL TIMELINES.
THIS ROLE ALSO CONTRIBUTES TO MAINTAINING ESTIMATING TOOLS, ANALYZING HISTORICAL PROPOSAL DATA, AND IDENTIFYING OPPORTUNITIES TO IMPROVE PRICING ACCURACY AND ESTIMATING EFFICIENCY.
ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
This list of duties and responsibilities is not all-inclusive and may be expanded to include other duties and responsibilities, as management may deem necessary from time to time.

• Develop cost estimates and pricing models for proposals and new business opportunities.

• Collaborate with Business Development, Client Delivery, Engineering, Product Solutions, and Finance teams to gather cost inputs and validate assumptions.

• Build and maintain detailed financial models and pricing templates that support proposal development.

• Analyze labor, operational, and program cost drivers to ensure accurate and competitive pricing.

• Support the development of price-to-win strategies through financial modeling and scenario analysis.

• Review proposal inputs to ensure cost assumptions are reasonable, consistent, and aligned with program requirements.

• Maintain documentation and version control for pricing models and supporting analysis.

• Analyze historical bid data and pricing trends to inform future estimating efforts.

• Assist in the development and refinement of standardized estimating tools and templates.

• Support reporting and analysis related to proposal performance, pricing accuracy, and estimating trends.

• Participate in process improvement initiatives to streamline estimating workflows and improve data quality.

• Provide financial analysis and insights to support proposal teams and leadership decision-making.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS
Education and Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, or related field required.

• 3-5 years of experience in cost estimating, financial analysis, pricing, budgeting, or related analytical roles.

• Experience supporting bid and proposal development processes preferred.

• Experience in energy, engineering, construction, consulting, government contracting, or infrastructure-related industries is a plus.

Required Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

• Strong financial modeling and analytical skills.

• Ability to analyze cost drivers and translate operational inputs into structured pricing models.

• High attention to detail and ability to ensure accuracy in complex financial models.

title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
description:
Who we are:

Mama Money is a growth stage fintech startup working to help migrant workers in South Africa send money home. Since 2015 we have been providing reliable remittances, at a socially fair price, to those that need it most. Mama HQ is in beautiful Cape Town, South Africa.
We are 131 people strong (and counting) from 19 countries across Africa, Asia, the UK, and Europe. Our culture is built around the well-being of our team membersand making a difference in our communities. “Just be lekker!” personifies our approach to work: we trust the wisdom of our talented and diverse team to do what is best for our customers and get the job done responsibly, without pedantic policies.
We’ve been around since 2015 and have earned a few accolades along the way, made some new friends,and expanded our reach. We've had some great times and some tough times, but we continue to focus on helping people rather than maximizing profit.
We’re seeking a Senior QA Engineer to champion a quality-first approach within our agile development team. In this role, you’ll be deeply involved throughout the entire software development life cycle, helping to ensure our products meet the highest standards.
How you will be working at Mama:
When a new feature is introduced by the product owner and architect during refinement, you’ll help ensure the team fully understands the requirements and system architecture. Using a tester’s critical mindset, you’ll question assumptions, uncover edge cases, and identify areas to improve testability, while forming an initial test strategy.
Once planning begins under the tech lead’s guidance, you’ll formalise this strategy into a document covering test scenarios, key integration points (API, app, queues, etc.), test data, and result verification.
As development progresses, you’ll deploy and configure updates in the QA environment, execute test cases, identify and investigate bugs, and log them with clear reproduction steps.
After development, you’ll verify the complete solution and sign off for production. You’ll also drive automation efforts, both for new and existing features, working with the QE Lead, maintaining test suites, and serving as the team’s automation expert.
Skills & tool experience we’re looking for:

title: QA/DevOps Engineer
description:
Discord has a highly engaged community of millions of daily active users who use the platform for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does: play video games. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming, and we are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We are seeking a QA/DevOps Engineer to join Discord’s Business Systems team. In this role, you will own automated test suite development and maintenance across Oracle ERP Cloud (Fusion) and Salesforce, with a focus on Tosca-based regression and progression testing. You will embed automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and partner closely with ERP Functional, Technical, and DevOps teams to ensure every release is tested consistently and defects are caught early.

What you'll be doing

• Run Oracle ERP Cloud and Salesforce QA automation suites for all quarterly patch upgrades end-to-end.

• Review new Oracle and SFDC release features and recommend improvements to existing testing processes.

• Build and improve regression and progression test automation in the Tosca environment for Oracle Fusion and Salesforce.

• Create, maintain, and update Tosca scripts to reflect system and process changes across GL, AP, AR, and FAH modules.

• Lead feature enhancement reviews as part of quarterly patch assessment cycles and new enhancement projects.

• Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines; trigger regression suites automatically on every release candidate build.

• Maintain test infrastructure and environments in collaboration with DevOps and ERP Technical teams.

• Document test coverage, defect trends, and release readiness in Jira and shared reporting dashboards.

Automation Use Cases

• FAH Process Automation: Auto-test Financial Accounting Hub on each new sales item addition to eliminate manual unit testing.

• AR Regression Suite: Automated flows for invoicing, receipts, and customer setup across every release.

• AP Regression Suite: Payment runs, supplier invoices, holds, and approvals tested automatically on each patch cycle.

• Salesforce Tosca Automation: Develop, maintain, and expand automated SFDC test suites in Tosca, integrated with release pipelines.

What you should have

• 3-5+ years of QA automation experience.

• Hands-on Tosca experience for regression and progression test suite development and maintenance.

• Experience executing and maintaining automated test cycles for quarterly Oracle patch upgrades.

• Familiarity with Oracle ERP Cloud and SFDC release feature review and technical impact assessment.

• Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or equivalent).

• Familiarity with pipeline configuration: triggering regression runs on pull requests and release candidate builds.

• Working knowledge of version control (Git / GitHub or GitLab): branching, pull requests, and code review workflows.

• Basic scripting capability in Python, Shell, or PowerShell for test utility automation and pipeline support.

• Understanding of containerized test environments (Docker); experience running tests in ephemeral containers is a plus.

• Jira for defect tracking, test coverage reporting, and sprint participation.

• Experience writing and maintaining test documentation: test plans, test cases, regression logs, and release readiness summaries.

• Ability to work cross-functionally with ERP Functional Analysts, ERP Technical Developers, and DevOps engineers.

• Familiarity with SOX compliance, ITGC controls, and ERP change management practices.

Preferred Qualifications

• Oracle Fusion certification or formal training in Oracle ERP Cloud modules.

• Experience with SaaS QA automation in a high-growth technology company environment.

• Exposure to OIC (Oracle Integration Cloud) or MuleSoft integration testing.

• Familiarity with Salesforce test automation frameworks

title: Partner Marketing Manager, Launches
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

This is a partner marketing role that demands product marketing craft. You'll be the single-threaded owner of how every Claude launch lands on partner marketing surfaces. We reach many of our most important customers through our partners. When we ship a new model or capability, it doesn't just launch on first-party surfaces; it launches across our growing partner ecosystem, each with their own product pages, blogs, seller enablement, and go-to-market motions. Our product release cadence has accelerated, and we're looking for someone to own that translation end-to-end.

Model and capabilities launches are the core of the job and the majority of the work. The rest is solution launches - the joint and co-built solutions that land on partner surfaces alongside our models. The two halves reinforce each other. Model launches create the moment; solution launches translate what’s possible for the sellers and customers on the other side.

You'll be the first dedicated owner of launch readiness across our partner surfaces, consolidating work currently spread across several people and creating a center of excellence for how we do this work. This role centralizes launch coordination for our partners - briefing partner teams under confidentiality, shaping how our positioning shows up on their surfaces, and orchestrating execution cross functionally. You'll be the person who knows exactly what's available on which surface, how we're messaging it, and how it all fits together. You will use this knowledge to ensure our launches are positioned for the highest impact and amplification across our partners.

The job is roughly half launch execution and half building. On the execution side, you'll run the launch playbook. On the building side, you'll define what we haven't had the bandwidth to create yet. You'll set the standard for how Anthropic shows up on partner surfaces and hold the rest of the company to it, without anyone involved reporting to you.

Anthropic reaches a substantial share of its customer base through partner surfaces, and the ecosystem is still growing. How Claude shows up on the platforms where enterprises actually buy AI is largely unwritten. This is the role that writes it.

Responsibilities

•
Own partner launch readiness end-to-end, serving as the directly responsible individual for every model, feature, and solution launch across the partner ecosystem - from the first briefing through launch-day go-live and reach reporting

•
Define the operating model for partner launches: set the standard for what readiness means, decide what's durable enough to share and when, and own the trade-offs when timelines and partner needs conflict

•
Equip partner sellers and solution architects to position Claude for a customer workload without escalating to us - segment-specific enablement, technical content, and the materials their field actually reaches for

•
Translate Anthropic positioning for partner surfaces, taking source messaging from Product Marketing and creating partner-specific versions that account for what's available where, what each partner needs to hear, and how the narrative lands on their platform

•
Own the go-to-market motion for joint and co-built solutions on partner surfaces - position what a partner and Anthropic have built together, make the value legible to that partner's sellers and customers, and land it across the channels where their buyers look

•
Work with Partnerships, Product, and partner-side teams to shape solutions into launchable moments, and make the call on which are worth a launch at all

•
Run launch execution - Manage cross-functional review cyc

title: Appeals and Grievances Specialist
description:
Sidecar Health is redefining health insurance. Our mission is to make excellent healthcare affordable and accessible for everyone. We know that to accomplish this lofty mission, we need driven people who will make things happen.
The passionate people who make up Sidecar Health ’s team come from all over, with backgrounds as tech leaders, policy makers, healthcare professionals, and beyond. And they all have one thing in common-the desire to fix a broken system and make it more personalized, affordable, and transparent.
If you want to use your talents to transform healthcare in the United States, come join us!
About the Role
As an Appeals and Grievances Specialist, you'll own the end-to-end handling of member and provider appeals and grievances, investigating cases, coordinating with internal teams, and delivering clear, well-reasoned resolutions within regulatory timelines.
This role sits at the intersection of advocacy, compliance, and operations. You'll work directly with members and providers who need someone to take their concern seriously, dig into the details, and get them an answer they can trust. You'll report to the Director, Quality and Continuous Improvement, and work closely with QA, Claims, Clinical, and Provider Relations to reach fair, well-documented outcomes.
What You'll Do

• Intake, triage, and manage a caseload of member and provider appeals and grievances from submission through resolution

• Investigate each case thoroughly, reviewing claims history, benefit determinations, clinical documentation, and prior correspondence

• Apply plan documents, state and federal regulations, and Sidecar Health policy to reach accurate, well-documented determinations

• Draft clear, compliant resolution letters and member and provider communications in Sidecar Health 's brand voice

• Track all cases and deadlines to ensure compliance with state and federal turnaround time requirements

• Coordinate with Claims, Clinical, Provider Relations, and Legal teams to gather information and resolve complex cases

• Identify escalation risks and loop in leadership or the Grievance Committee when a case requires second-level review

• Spot patterns in appeals and grievances that point to upstream process, system, or communication issues, and flag them to leadership

• Maintain accurate records in the case management system to support audits and regulatory reporting

• Contribute to process improvements, SOP updates, and knowledge base articles for the appeals and grievance’s function

What You'll Bring

• Bachelor's degree required, in a relevant field such as healthcare administration, business, public health, or a related discipline

• 3+ years of experience in appeals and grievances, claims adjudication, utilization review, or a related health insurance operations role

• Working knowledge of health insurance regulatory requirements for appeals and grievances (state DOI requirements, ERISA, ACA as applicable)

• Strong analytical skills, comfortable reading claims data, plan documents, and clinical notes to form a defensible conclusion

• Excellent written communication skills; able to explain complex determination in plain, empathetic language

• A track record of managing a caseload independently and meeting hard deadlines

• Comfort working across systems and teams to track down the information a case needs

• A member-first mindset, balanced with rigorous attention to policy and compliance

Nice to haves

• Experience with Genesys Cloud, Salesforce, or similar case management and CRM platforms

• Familiarity with Medicare Advantage or ACA marketplace appeals processes

• Prior experience in a fast-growing or start-up health insurance environment

What You'll Get

• Competitive salary ($65,000 - $75,000), bonus opportunity, and equity package

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

• A 401k retirement plan

• Paid vacation and company holidays

• Opportunity to make an impact at a rapidly growing mission-drive

title: Sr Customer Success Executive

HealthEdge 's customer success strategy depends on four organizational capabilities: achieving customer outcomes, retaining and converting referenceable customers, expanding revenue within the existing customer base, and maintaining data and reporting integrity. The Senior CSE is the primary delivery vehicle for all four.
This is not a relationship management role. It is an outcome ownership role. A Senior CSE at HealthEdge is accountable for the promise between what a customer bought and what they are getting - and for resolving customer issues before they become an escalation, a churn risk, or a missed expansion opportunity.

title: AI Automation Engineer

ABOUT VALSOFT:
Valsoft is a global firm that acquires and grows mission-critical vertical market software companies. Since 2015, we have built a portfolio of 150+ companies across 30+ industries, comprising 4,000+ employees in over 20 countries.
We're building the infrastructure, tools, and talent to make every business in our portfolio AI-native. We're hiring across 150+ vertical market software businesses in the Valsoft portfolio. The right candidate will be matched to a specific business where they can have an outsized impact from day one and an opportunity to work across multiple businesses over time.
THE OPPORTUNITY:
Engineers at Valsoft go where the hardest problems are - embedded directly inside portfolio companies, working alongside operators, product teams, and customers to solve complex, messy, high-stakes challenges that can't be fixed from a distance.
As an AI Automation Engineer, you'll be the person who figures out how to make a business run better end to end. The product, internal ops, customer experience, back office - if it's manual and repeatable, it's your target. You're not here to consult. You're here to build and ship.
What you’ll do

• Embed inside portfolio companies to audit their workflows across every department and identify automation opportunities

• Translate messy, manual processes into clean, reliable automated systems - using AI, no-code, custom code, or whatever actually works

• Interview stakeholders, map processes, and diagnose root causes before writing a line of code

• Build and deploy automation across operations, sales, customer support, reporting, and internal tooling

• Own the full delivery cycle: scoping, building, shipping, measuring, and iterating

• Work directly with company leadership to prioritize what gets built and communicate ROI clearly

• Operate across multiple portfolio companies over time, building a repeatable playbook for what works

• Proven experience automating real business workflows - not just experiments, but things that shipped and stuck

• Strong technical foundation - you can build production-quality solutions, not just prototypes

• High comfort with ambiguity - you thrive when the brief is "this is costing us time but we don't know why"

• Strong communicator - you can explain what you built, why it works, and what it's worth to non-technical leadership

• Self-starter who moves fast and leaves systems better than you found them

What success looks like

•
Within 30 days: You've completed a full workflow audit and have a clear, prioritized automation roadmap

•
Within 90 days: At least two high-impact automations are live and driving measurable time or cost savings

•
Within 6 months: You're a trusted resource with a track record of shipped solutions and real outcomes

•
Long-term: You've built a repeatable playbook that defines how Valsoft operationalizes automation across its businesses - and you've got the metrics to prove it

title: Workplace & People Operations - Intern
description:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.

At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As our Workplace & People Operations Intern, you will support the daily running of our Berlin office while gaining hands-on experience across core People Operations processes.

You will help coordinate the practical details that enable employees to work effectively, from office operations and IT requests to onboarding, employee documentation and internal events.

This is a primarily onsite role in our Berlin office.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

WORKPLACE OPERATIONS

- Support the daily operation of the Berlin office, ensuring that workspaces, meeting rooms and shared areas are organized and ready for use.

- Coordinate routine requests with building management, external vendors and service providers.

- Manage office supplies, deliveries, access cards and other workplace-related requests.

- Coordinate with IT on equipment preparation, access requests, technical issues and the return of devices.

- Help organize office events, team activities and employee initiatives.

- Gather employee feedback and contribute ideas for improving the workplace experience.

PEOPLE OPERATIONS

- Support employee onboarding and offboarding, including documentation, equipment, system access and first-day preparation.

- Assist with maintaining accurate employee records and updating information in our People systems.

- Respond to straightforward employee questions and direct more complex or sensitive topics to the appropriate People team member.

- Support recurring People processes and internal projects.

- Help document and improve Workplace and People Operations processes.

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You are currently studying or have recently completed studies in human resources, business administration, hospitality, office management or a related field.

- You are interested in developing practical experience across both Workplace and People Operations.

- You are organized, dependable and comfortable coordinating several tasks and stakeholders at the same time.

- You communicate clearly and follow through on commitments.

- You handle employee information with care, discretion and confidentiality.

- You are comfortable working with digital tools and learning new systems.

- You have strong English communication skills. German language skills are a strong advantage when coordinating with local vendors and service providers.

- You can work primarily onsite in Berlin for 30 hours per week.

- You have the right to work in Germany for the duration of the internship.

WHAT YOU GET

- Work on digitalizing core operating systems for food distributors, automating orders, sales and payments in a system that still largely runs on calls and spreadsheets.

- Work with an AI product with proven product-market fit, already embedded in distributor workflows and directly affecting order accuracy, speed, and margins.

- Join a global team across 6 countries and 40+ nationalities, building a company that has raised $300M+ and reached unicorn status (~$1.2B valuation) with the ambition to define this category end-to-end.

title: Ingénieur(e) Full Stack Senior, HTS Assist// Senior Full Stack Engineer (Realtime & Voice) Customer Experience Platform
description:
À propos du poste

HTS Assist est l'assistant d'intelligence artificielle agentique d'Hopper pour le voyage. Il résout de véritables enjeux clients, notamment les changements de vol, les annulations, les remboursements et les réservations, par clavardage et par la voix, pour certaines des plus grandes marques de voyage au monde. Nous recherchons un ingénieur ou une ingénieure full stack sénior pour piloter ce produit, en assurant la responsabilité complète de la couche vocale et temps réel, tout en contribuant à l'ensemble de la pile technologique : interfaces React/TypeScript, services Scala et Python, et infrastructure infonuagique. L'équipe est restreinte et expérimentée, la portée des responsabilités est large, et le chemin entre votre code et l'appel téléphonique d'un voyageur est court.

À quoi ressemblera votre quotidien

- Assurer la responsabilité complète du canal vocal, y compris les intégrations de téléphonie et de CPaaS (par exemple Twilio, Amazon Connect), les pipelines de reconnaissance et de synthèse vocale en continu, l'orchestration de modèles en temps réel, ainsi que les budgets de latence et de qualité

- Développer des fonctionnalités sur l'ensemble de la pile technologique, y compris des interfaces de clavardage web en React/TypeScript, des services back-end en Scala et Python, et une infrastructure sur GCP

- Concevoir une architecture multilocataire, où un seul code source dessert plusieurs partenaires par configuration plutôt que par des versions distinctes

- Construire les mécanismes de sécurité et de conformité audités par les partenaires d'entreprise, notamment les garde-fous, le filtrage de contenu et les points d'intégration de la rédaction des renseignements personnels

- Maintenir la santé des déploiements essentiels aux revenus grâce à l'observabilité, aux alertes, à la gestion des incidents et au respect des ententes de niveau de service

- Développer les capacités de plateforme que nos ingénieurs déployés sur le terrain configurent pour les intégrations de téléphonie des partenaires et les mises en production

- Contribuer à l'excellence technique de l'équipe par la révision de code, les revues d'architecture et le mentorat

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

- Plus de 6 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel, avec une responsabilité de niveau sénior sur des systèmes en production et une réelle polyvalence full stack

- Une expérience concrète des systèmes en temps réel : applications vocales, WebRTC/SIP, diffusion multimédia en continu, ou produits comparables à faible latence

- Une solide maîtrise d'un cadre front-end moderne (React, TypeScript) et une expertise back-end (Scala ou un autre langage JVM, et/ou Python), ainsi qu'une expérience en infrastructure infonuagique (GCP ou AWS)

- Une expérience dans la conception, le développement et la maintenance d'API RESTful, de microservices ou de systèmes pilotés par événements

- L'utilisation des outils d'intelligence artificielle pour la programmation comme partie intégrante de son flux de travail, avec le jugement nécessaire pour réviser, corriger et assumer la responsabilité de tout ce qui est mis en production

- Une mentalité axée sur l'exploitabilité des systèmes : ententes de niveau de service, observabilité, astreintes et plans de retour en arrière

- La capacité à décomposer des problèmes complexes, à faire des compromis pragmatiques et à livrer de façon itérative, appuyée par une communication solide avec les équipes de produit, de conception et d'opérations

- Un atout : une expérience en IA conversationnelle ou en orchestration de modèles de langage, y compris des technologies vocales comme Deepgram, ElevenLabs, Whisper ou OpenAI Realtime

- Un atout : une connaissance pratique des plateformes de téléphonie infonuagique ou CPaaS telles que Twilio, Amazon Connect, Genesys ou LiveKit

- Un atout : une expérience dans la création d'outils de service à la clientèle, de gestion de la relation client, de centre de contact ou d'automat

title: QA Lead | Offshore
description:
Job Description:
As a QA Lead, you will be responsible for overseeing the quality assurance process and ensuring that our products meet the highest standards of quality and reliability. You will lead a team of QA engineers, define testing strategies, and implement best practices to identify and prevent defects throughout the software development lifecycle.
Responsibilities:

• Lead and mentor a team of QA engineers, providing guidance and support in all aspects of quality assurance.

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

• Proven experience in software quality assurance, including at least 2 years in a leadership role.

• Strong understanding of QA methodologies, tools, and processes.

• Experience with test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, Appium, JUnit, TestNG).

• Proficiency in programming/scripting languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.

• Familiarity with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) pipelines and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD).

• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen attention to detail.

• Strong communication and leadership skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with cross-functional teams.

• Experience with Agile/Scrum methodologies is a plus.

• ISTQB or other relevant certifications are desirable but not required.

title: Sr. Staff Software Development Engineer
description:
About Zscaler

Zscaler accelerates digital transformation to ensure our customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. As an AI-forward enterprise , we are constantly pushing the envelope, leveraging the world’s largest security data lake to power our cloud-native Zero Trust Exchange platform. This innovation protects our customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location.

Here, impact in your role matters more than title and trust is built on results. We say, impact over activity. We seek innovators who actively use AI to amplify their impact and who thrive in an environment where we leverage intelligent systems to stay ahead of evolving threats. We believe in transparency and value constructive, honest debate -we’re focused on getting to the best ideas, faster. We build high-performing teams that can make an impact quickly and with high quality. To do this, we are building a culture of execution centered on customer obsession , collaboration, ownership, and accountability.

We value high-impact, high-accountability with a sense of urgency where you’re enabled to do your best work and embrace your potential. If you’re driven by purpose, thrive on solving complex challenges, and want to be part of the team that’s helping to secure the AI age, we invite you to bring your talents to Zscaler and help shape the future of cybersecurity.

Role  

We are looking for a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a San Jose, CA role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Zero Trust Exchange department. We are hiring a Senior Staff Software Development Engineer to drive the evolution of our Client Connector Agent (CCA), a critical Windows client that provides secure connectivity, tunneling, and session management across enterprise and VDI environments. In this role, you will own core service-layer components including RPC, user session handling, and data pipelines to ensure CCA remains performant, scalable, resilient, and maintainable.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Design and implement features across the CCA service, user-mode UI, and supporting subsystems including the RPC server, session handler, data handler, and tunnel telemetry

• Diagnose and fix complex production issues such as service crashes, race conditions, lifetime bugs, and cross-process synchronization problems

• Improve reliability of long-running Windows service code including cleanup/shutdown paths and inter-process communication

• Work on VDI-specific flows including ZCC VDI SMB tunnel traffic accounting and session lifecycle management

• Review peers' code, raise the quality bar, and mentor other engineers on Windows systems programming

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You thrive in ambiguity and see dynamic, complex environments as an opportunity to build meaningful solutions.

• You act like an owner, driving initiatives forward with passion, integrity, and a strong bias for action.

• You are a high-trust collaborator who embraces a challenge culture with clear, respectful, and constructive feedback.

• You are customer-obsessed, grounding engineering decisions in deep empathy to solve real-world problems.

• You champion simplicity by distilling complex technical concepts into clear, actionable plans.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain

• 8+ years of production software engineering experience with strong C++ (C++14/17) expertise

• Solid grasp of Windows internals including services, user sessions, security tokens, IPC, and process/thread lifetime

• Experience debugging multithreaded C++ including races, deadlocks, iterator invalidation, and use-after-free

• Proficiency with diagnostic tools like WinDbg, ETW, Process Monitor,

title: Deliver Manager
description:
About Moonsong Labs

Moonsong Labs is an engineering company that designs and builds production-grade blockchain and AI systems for institutional finance. We help customers modernize money movement, create tokenized asset products, build institutional blockchain infrastructure, and automate financial workflows with AI.

We have delivered projects for clients such as Matter Labs, Canton Network and Solana. MSL has established a reputation for engineering robust, production-grade solutions that secure billions in institutional digital asset value. View our case study portfolio here.

Your Role

Moonsong Labs (MSL) is hiring a senior Delivery Manager to own end-to-end delivery and client success for service engagements.

This role is accountable for delivery outcomes (scope, timeline, budget, and client confidence) and partners closely with Principal Engineers, who are responsible for technical architecture and execution.

The Delivery Manager is the accountable owner of the engagement - ensuring projects are well-run, risks are proactively managed and clients have high confidence in how their engagement is being delivered. They work in close partnership with a Principal Engineer, who owns technical direction.

This is a senior delivery leadership role, not a project coordination function.

What you'll do:

• Own the post-sale client relationship and serve as the primary point of accountability for delivery.

• Translate client goals and SOWs into clear delivery plans, milestones, priorities, and dependencies.

• Own scope, timeline, budget, and change control, ensuring delivery remains commercially healthy.

• Proactively identify risks, delays, and tradeoffs; surface them early and drive resolution.

• Drive execution against plan, coordinate team priorities, remove blockers, and maintain momentum.

• Partner with Principal Engineers on estimation, sequencing, feasibility, and technical constraints.

• Translate technical tradeoffs into clear client decisions around scope, priorities, timeline, and budget.

• Maintain visibility into project health, utilization, financial performance, and expansion opportunities.

• Own client-facing delivery documentation and help evolve MSL’s delivery practices, reporting, escalation, and handoffs.

• Manage deliverable acceptance and formal client sign-off against the SOW and agreed criteria.

What you'll bring:

• Highly literate in blockchain or AI systems to follow the tradeoffs and turn them into clear client decisions.

• Able to partner credibly with Principal Engineers on estimation, sequencing and feasibility, without owning the technical architecture yourself.

• Proven track record owning delivery for complex software or services engagements, end to end, ideally within fintech, banks or payment providers.

• Confident with senior client stakeholders including C-level and skilled at earning their trust.

• Experience turning SOWs and client goals into clear plans, milestones and dependencies

• Strong command of scope, timeline, budget and change control, keeping engagements healthy and commercially sound.

• Able to spot risks early and drive them to resolution before they hit delivery.

• Comfortable coordinating engineering teams, removing blockers and keeping momentum.

• Experience shaping delivery practices such as reporting, escalation and handoffs.

• Commercial instinct - you track utilization, margins and financial health and you notice where an account can grow.

• A clear, precise communicator who makes complex work easy to grasp for technical and non-technical people.

Perks and Benefits:

• 100% Remote

• Flexible vacation policy

• Twice a year company retreats

• Health and Dental plans (for US based employees)

Ready to Shape the Future? Join Us Today!

Equal Opportunity is the law, and at Moonsong Labs , we are ardently committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship
